name: DHAKSHINESWAR SURESH
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A towering 6’6” player with a booming serve (15 aces in his ATP singles debut), strong net skills, and an aggressive all-court game, excelling in doubles.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #779 (November 11, 2024), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #1450 (August 8, 2022).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ATP Debut: Reached the semifinals in doubles at the 2024 Winston-Salem Open (ATP 250) with Luca Pow via wildcard, marking his first ATP main draw appearance. College Success: Named to the 2024 All-ACC Doubles First Team with Holden Koons at Wake Forest, achieving a #1 ITA doubles ranking (March 8–April 14, 2024) and a 25-5 record. ITF Titles: Won 1 ITF Futures singles title (2025 M25 Bhopal). Junior Success: Secured boys’ singles and doubles titles at the 2017 Adidas-MCC National Junior U-18 Championship.
Other Highlights: Transferred from Georgia Gwinnett College (2023 NAIA All-American) to Wake Forest. Aims to crack the Top 200 by 2026 while completing his degree.
Dhakshineswar is a rising star blending college tennis dominance with pro aspirations. 🎾🇮🇳
